description: STA2002 data analysis coursework with a brief only (no rubric): a single Jupyter notebook (code, stored outputs and a markdown interpretation) analysing sales_data.xlsx (12 months of North/South sales). Tests BRIEF_ONLY mode, notebook parsing including stored outputs, XLSX supporting data, DATA_STATISTICS specialist review, and cross-checking written figures against stored outputs. True values: North mean 101.67, median 101.5, SD 4.91; South mean 92.50, median 92.5, SD 3.90; Student t = 5.069, df = 22, p = 4.46e-05. Deliberate defects: (1) the bar chart code sets no axis labels and no title; (2) no assumption checks (normality / equal variance) are performed or discussed; (3) null and alternative hypotheses are not stated anywhere; (4) the Interpretation markdown cell states the North mean as 102.37, 0.7 higher than the stored descriptive-statistics output (101.67).
